entities.summary: Eloy Alfaro, a notable figure in the history of Ecuador, associated with García Moreno's Theocracy and the Liberal Revolution (1895–1912). Preceded by Radical Liberal Revolution and Liberal Revolution under Alfaro. Their legacy influenced Alfaro lynched and burned in Quito — January 28, 1912 and Velasco Ibarra elected president five times, completed only one term.
